edition.notes: The complete 1957 official-gazette volume. Printed pp. 91-95 contain the Sacred Congregation of Rites' Ordinationes et declarationes circa Ordinem hebdomadae sanctae instauratum, dated 1 February 1957.
edition.title: Acta Apostolicae Sedis, volume 49

passages.context: The Sacred Congregation of Rites' Ordinationes et declarationes circa Ordinem hebdomadae sanctae instauratum incorporate the declaration of 15 March 1956, preserve the force of the decree and instruction of 16 November 1955 except where innovated here, and give twenty-two numbered provisions for Palm Sunday and the Sacred Triduum. The act is dated 1 February 1957 and subscribed by Cardinal Cicognani and Archbishop Carinci.
passages.notes: The complete five-page act was inspected in the official volume. The opening and final pages were also checked as rendered page images. It controls the stated amendments but is not the 1957 Ritus Pontificalis ceremonial book.
